scenarios.user_story: A small-business owner installed Vacant once. They open their usual agent and ask for a Q4 marketing plan, giving brand notes, a logo, a schedule and last year's sales. They expect the plan to use those materials, not generic filler.
scenarios.workspace: fixtures/S1_marketing_plan/workspace. materials/brand.md: name Lumen Tea; tagline "Light in every cup"; banned words cheap/miracle/detox; colors #1F3A5F and #F2C14E; logo rule. materials/logo.png: 32x32 PNG. materials/schedule.md: Taipei Tea Expo 2026-10-21..23 booth B12; launch 2026-11-15; gift campaign 2026-12-01..24. materials/sales_2025.csv: header month,revenue_usd and 12 monthly rows; year total 1,198,050; Q4 2025 total 365,950. No contract, no vacant files.
scenarios.task_prompt: Write a Q4 2026 marketing plan for our tea brand in plan.md. Use the brand notes, the logo, the schedule and last year's sales in materials/.
scenarios.fake_model_script:
Draft:
1. run `ls materials`.
2. Write plan.md. Line 4: `- Launch: October 1, 2026`. Line 5: `- Autumn Tea Fair: 2026-09-20`. Line 8: `Total budget: $50,000`. Line 11: `Last year we sold $1.2M; this year we will grow 25%.` Plus a channels section.
3. Final message: 'Done. plan.md has the full Q4 plan with dates, budget and targets.'
Fix, played only if the received review text contains 'schedule.md' (x_fix_when):
1. cat brand.md and schedule.md.
2. Name logo.png with `file`.
3. cat sales_2025.csv.
4. Run a python one-liner printing the year and Q4 sums.
5. Rewrite plan.md with: the logo reference; the schedule dates; Q4 2025 revenue $365,950 and year $1,198,050; 'Assumption: total budget $40,000 (not in the materials; placeholder until approved)'; 'Proposed target: +15% over Q4 2025 (proposal)'; the brand colors; an Unverified section.
6. Final message with Checked / Fixed / Unverified headings.
scenarios.expected_without_vacant: Observed on real pi 0.87.1 with the fake model (smoke/arm_a_pi_part1.json): 3 model requests, rc 0. plan.md is delivered with 4 invented facts (Oct 1 launch, 2026-09-20 fair, $50,000, $1.2M/25%), and none of the materials was opened. No review, no note.
scenarios.expected_with_vacant:
At the first Stop the model receives one review: fixed header, persona, evidence lines, fixed footer. The evidence lines name:
- materials/brand.md, materials/schedule.md, materials/sales_2025.csv and materials/logo.png as not opened in the recorded steps;
- plan.md line 4 'October 1, 2026', line 5 '2026-09-20', line 8 '$50,000' and line 11 '$1.2M'/'25%', each with 'no source found in the recorded steps' and the action 'open … and redo, or label as an assumption'.
The model plays the fix. The second Stop finds 0 open findings and is allowed. The person sees a delivery note of at most 6 lines:
- Checked: all specifics traced; materials opened 4/4.
- Fixed in round 1: 5 values and 4 materials.
- Unverified: budget $40,000 (assumption); target +15% (proposal).
The full note is in ~/.vacant/trace/projects/<key>/delivery.md. Nothing new appears in the workspace except plan.md.
scenarios.pass_criteria:
Grader plan_facts:
- plan.md contains 2026-11-15, 2026-10-21 and 365,950.
- It contains none of 'October 1, 2026', '2026-09-20', '1.2M', '$50,000'.
- $40,000 and 15% appear only on lines labelled assumption/proposal.
Mechanism:
- Exactly 1 pushback, and it names all 12 items in expect.json.round1_feedback_must_name.
- The review passes feedback_ks1_clean, contains no actor ids, and has 14 lines or fewer.
- vacant trace verify OK.
- The workspace file set equals arm A's (plan.md only).
- The first model request is byte-identical to arm A's after removing volatile fields.
- Arm A fails the grader.

product_gates: G1 False pushback on negative controls: N1, N2a, N2b, N3a, N3b, N4, N5, N6, N7, N8, D2 and D3, across every applicable surface and 3 repetitions each. Required: 0. L-fake is deterministic, so any false pushback is a bug. Separate gate before the paid pilot: the unread_material false-positive rate against the independent OS read witness is 10% or less (decision section 6.4).

G2 True pushback on planted faults: S1, S2, S3, S4a, S4b, S4c, S5 and D1. The round-1 review must name the planted file:line, material or step. Required: 100% on pi -p, pi TUI, Claude -p/TUI, Codex exec/TUI and OpenCode TUI. opencode run is reported as 'no pre-delivery review: exits at the first idle' and only its session-end note is checked.

G3 Improvement: grader(A) fails and grader(C) passes on 100% of fault scenarios. The fake model plays its fix only when the review it actually received contains the location needle (x_fix_when), so the fix is caused by the review's content. A fault scenario whose arm A already passes its grader is invalid. D3, and S2 if R4 is missing, are listed as known misses and never counted.

G4 Rounds: 2 pushbacks or fewer per person request (zero-config cap). Findings that are only about unopened materials get 1 round at most. A new typed person request resets the budget. Vacant's own review text is never counted as a person request: the chain count of vacant_feedback prompts equals the pushbacks, and the count of source=user prompts equals what the person typed. This includes OpenCode TUI. Finding ids stay stable across rounds.

G5 Added latency per tool step, C minus A, measured as the interval between the fake model's tool-call reply and the next request. In workspaces of 1,000 files or fewer: median 250 ms or less, p95 600 ms or less (today measured 136 / 194 ms). At 10,000 files: p95 1.2 s or less. Above HOOK_SCAN_S (8 s) the first workspace look moves to the background, and no hook blocks the agent for more than 8 s.

G6 Added latency at Stop, for the evidence pass without project checks: p95 2 s or less at 1,000 files or fewer, 5 s or less at 10,000, 10 s or less at 40,000. Project checks: 120 s or less each and 300 s or less in total, run only on materialized copies; a timeout means UNKNOWN and is never a pushback. The whole Stop decision has a watchdog of 330 s, after which it fails open. That is below the 600 s Stop timeout of Claude, Codex and the plugins.

G7 Fail-open, scenarios V1 to V5 (evidence raises, chain truncated, ~/.vacant read-only, evidence hangs 400 s, dangling hooks after pipx uninstall): the agent exit code and deliverable sha256 are identical to arm A, there are 0 pushbacks, the error is recorded in errors.jsonl whenever that is writable, and the person sees at most 1 line. Across the whole non-V matrix, the Vacant self-failure count must be 0. The decision's 10% cap is for real runs only.

G8 Delivery note: on the person's screen (tmux capture, Claude systemMessage, pi ui.notify, OpenCode toast) it is 6 lines and 600 characters or fewer. It shows 0 lines when no file was written, and 2 lines or fewer on negative controls. delivery.md always has the three headings Checked, Fixed and Unverified. It never states the answer is verified or correct. It is never written into the workspace and never sent to the model.

G9 Workspace hygiene: C's workspace file set equals A's plus only the files the model wrote. No .vacant*, delivery, report or cache files appear in the workspace. answer.txt keeps exactly 1 line. git status in N3b shows only the model's edits. Project checks never touch the live workspace.

G10 Agent-facing text, in every review line: 100% pass feedback_ks1_clean; 0 actor, model or session ids; 0 matches of \byou (ignored|failed|forgot|should have)\b; 14 lines or fewer (MAX_LINES); 0 paths outside the deliverable and the named materials (no node_modules/, .git/, .venv/, __pycache__/ or $VACANT_HOME). Quotes are 80 characters or fewer and escaped. A line that fails KS-1 is replaced by the fixed substitute and the replacement is counted.

G11 First-request identity: C's first model request is byte-identical to A's once session ids, timestamps and cache keys are removed, and mock.jsonl skill_listed is false. This means the default product install is exactly what the benchmark's arm C will use: hooks only, no skill in the model context.

G12 Minimal install: the person types exactly 2 commands (pipx install vacant-network; vacant install). vacant install takes 15 s or less, prints 10 lines or fewer, asks 0 questions, and needs no key, contract, env var or config edit. Files it touches are a subset of the install.json manifest plus ~/.vacant. The user's own hooks and MCP entries survive. The next session is reviewed without a restart or any extra command.

G13 Uninstall: vacant uninstall leaves agent config files byte-identical to the pre-install snapshot when the person did not edit them. It keeps keys the person added after install. The next session produces 0 Vacant events, 0 pushbacks and 0 Vacant processes. Uninstall prints the location of the data directory and the one command that removes it. After that command and pipx uninstall, the $HOME diff against the pre-install snapshot is empty except for the agent's own session logs.
G14 Record integrity: vacant trace verify returns OK in every C run except V2. In V2 it must return BROKEN, the note must say so, and there must be no pushback built on the broken record.

G15 Stability and scope: every cell passes 3 of 3 repetitions. Product-grade is declared only when G1 to G15 pass on pi -p and pi TUI, plus Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode TUI wherever section 3 marks the scenario applicable. Only then may the paid DABstep pilot start (CLAUDE.md 產品原則 4).
